## Coming soon

This case study is in development. It will show how predictive modeling can identify retention risk while incorporating calibration, intervention economics and monitoring to determine which predictions are actionable.

The focus will be the decision system—not merely model performance—including who to prioritize, when intervention is economically justified and how results should be monitored after deployment.
